Who is Dan Finlay in connection with MetaMask? Describe his contribution and any historical details you know.

responses.content:
Dan Finlay is a co-founder of MetaMask, alongside Aaron Davis, in 2016. His primary contribution was as the lead designer and UX architect. He is specifically credited with designing the core user experience, including the Secret Recovery Phrase (seed phrase) interface and the transaction confirmation flow, which helped make self-custody accessible to non-technical users.

Historically, he was a prominent figure at ConsenSys and a vocal advocate for user sovereignty and minimizing trust in the user interface. He also wrote extensively on Ethereum philosophy and decentralized identity. He later stepped back from his day-to-day leadership role at MetaMask to pursue other projects, but he remains a foundational figure in the wallet's history and the broader Web3 UX movement.
